props.text: Our sunburn treatment is a one-hour aloe vera massage with light, non-irritating movements that cools and rehydrates skin after too much sun. It is for mild sunburn, when skin feels hot, dry or tight; blistered or severely burned skin needs a doctor, not a massage.

props.title: What to Expect from a Sunburn Treatment
props.text: Your therapist checks your skin first, then works slowly, adjusting each step to how it feels. A typical session involves:

items.question: What should I do for sunburn in Bali?
items.answer: Cool the skin with a cool shower or a damp towel, drink plenty of water, apply plain aloe vera gel and stay out of the sun while it heals. See a doctor if the skin blisters, or if you have a fever, chills or feel dizzy. Once the skin has calmed, Spa Bali Moon's one-hour aloe vera treatment in Seminyak gives cooling, gentle care; it isn't suitable for blistered skin.

items.question: Can I get a massage if I have sunburn?
items.answer: Yes, provided the skin is not blistered or severely damaged. The sunburn treatment at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak avoids deep pressure and uses cooling aloe vera with gentle techniques specifically intended for sensitive skin. If your skin is blistered or severely burned, see a doctor instead.

items.question: Why is aloe vera used for sunburn?
items.answer: Aloe vera is widely used in after-sun care because of its cooling properties and its ability to help maintain skin hydration while soothing temporary discomfort. The sunburn treatment at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak applies cooling aloe vera with light, non-irritating movements for 1 hour, at our spa or at your villa or hotel.

items.question: Can I have the sunburn treatment straight after the beach?
items.answer: Yes. Many guests book the sunburn treatment at Spa Bali Moon after spending long hours outdoors, at the beach or by the pool, to help cool and rehydrate their skin. It is not suitable for blistered or severely burned skin.

items.question: Does sunburn turn into a tan?
items.answer: Sometimes, but it is not a safe way to tan. A sunburn can be followed by tanning as the skin produces more melanin, but a sunburn is a sign of skin damage. For mild sunburn, the sunburn treatment at Spa Bali Moon cools and rehydrates the skin with aloe vera.

items.question: Does the sunburn treatment cover the whole body?
items.answer: It can. During the sunburn treatment at Spa Bali Moon, your therapist may treat the whole body or concentrate on the sun-exposed areas that need the most attention, such as the shoulders, upper back, arms, legs or chest. The affected areas are checked first.

items.question: How long does sunburn last?
items.answer: Mild sunburns usually improve within a few days and heal within about a week. More severe sunburns can take longer to heal, especially if the skin blisters or peels. For mild sunburn, Spa Bali Moon's sunburn treatment in Seminyak cools and rehydrates the skin; for blistered or severely burned skin, see a doctor.

items.question: Can I return to the sun after my appointment?
items.answer: Not straight away. Give your skin time to recover before more sun, and use sun protection when you go out again.

items.question: How much does a sunburn treatment cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: The sunburn treatment at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak costs IDR 250.000 per person for 1 hour. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area. You can pay by Visa, Mastercard or cash, and book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, between 9am and 11pm daily.

items.question: Can I get the sunburn treatment if my skin is blistered?
items.answer: No. The sunburn treatment at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak is for mild sunburn, when skin feels hot, dry or tight after beach or pool days. If your skin is blistered or severely burned, the treatment is not suitable and you should see a doctor first. Your therapist checks the skin condition before the treatment starts.

items.question: Can I have the sunburn treatment at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. A Spa Bali Moon therapist comes from our Seminyak spa to your villa, hotel or home with fresh linen and everything the aloe vera treatment needs. It costs the same as at the spa, plus a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist in Seminyak, Petitenget and Kerobokan, or IDR 150.000 in Canggu, North Kuta and Kuta. Book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, 9am to 11pm.

items.question: Can I book a sunburn treatment for today?
items.answer: Often, yes, depending on availability. Message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 between 9am and 11pm with the time you'd like. At our Seminyak spa we confirm the next free time; at a villa or hotel in the Seminyak area a therapist usually arrives within 30 to 60 minutes. For a set time, or for two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my sunburn treatment?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your sunburn treatment on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.
